content: 9front libc/arm64 mkfile: SFILES=argv0.s atom.s cycles.s getcallerpc.s getfcr.s main9.s main9p.s memmove.s memset.s setjmp.s tas.s; CFILES=lock.c notejmp.c _seek.c; OS=7 (object suffix 7). No div/vlop/vlrt (native 64-bit divide). arm64/include/u.h has arm64 va_list (char* based, 8-byte slots) and FPdbleword; ureg.h: r0-r30, sp, pc, psr, type. Syscall stubs (9syscall/mkfile 'case arm64'): MOV R0,0(FP); MOV $n,R0; SVC; RETURN — first arg passed in R0 register by 7c calling convention, saved to stack home slot so kernel reads whole arg block from user stack; syscall number in R0; return value in R0.
